name: Risk + Feasibility
producesProse: Risk register (technical / legal / privacy / operational / cost), mitigations.

exitCriteria.describe: Every high-severity risk has a mitigation or an accepted-risk signoff.
The design's load-bearing assertions are enumerated and each has reached its required confidence rung; an empty enumeration is n/a with a reason, not satisfied (#25, #42).

purpose: Name what could make this fail, and get every load-bearing assertion to the confidence it needs.

method.summary: Agree the risk register with the operator, and raise each load-bearing assertion to its required rung.
steps: Read the design and the assertions the plan rests on.
Enumerate the design claims whose failure would change the plan, and ensure each is represented by a load-bearing assertion; if there are none, state why before proposing n/a.
Draft the risk register in chat: one row per credible failure, with its category, its severity, and its mitigation or a proposed accepted-risk signoff.
Do not create a typed artifact for a risk or substitute another type for one; `risk` has no schema or tool (DEC-0013), and the register is prose.
Ask the operator to review the register, and record their reply with `writeStageDocument`.
Delegate to the validation specialist to run the declared check behind any assertion below its required rung.
Link the returned evidence to the assertion it bears on.
In the `high-severity-risks-mitigated` attestation, name each high-severity risk and the mitigation or the operator's accepted-risk signoff behind it.
In the `load-bearing-assertions-at-rung` attestation, name each load-bearing assertion and its derived rung; if the enumeration is empty, record n/a with the reason instead of satisfied.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Resolve a blocking question first; delegate to validation when an assertion is below its rung; author or revise while any high-severity risk lacks a mitigation or a signoff; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: An assertion below its required rung is not treated as settled (#25, #42).
An empty load-bearing-assertion set is recorded n/a with a reason; it never satisfies a universal claim vacuously.
A high-severity risk is mitigated or has an accepted-risk signoff; it is not carried silently.
The risk register is the one the operator reviewed; a risk the operator has not seen is not attested.

approvalBoundary.approves: That every high-severity risk is mitigated or accepted, by the operator.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: The risks and the mitigation or signoff behind each.
Assertions still below their required rung.
